selected_problem: Fresh main hard-gated expectedHeadSha inside gitRemoteDelivery, gitPushBranch, and GitHub merge, but exported githubCreatePullRequest still allowed a direct caller to perform a PR-create external side effect with no expected validated head binding.
changes: githubCreatePullRequest now requires expectedHeadSha before any GitHub POST side effect.
The expected head must resolve to a real local commit before PR creation proceeds.
A regression proves an unbound direct call fails with EXPECTED_HEAD_SHA_REQUIRED and performs zero fetch calls.
Existing PR receipt/provider tests now carry the expected validated head and valid merge receipt fixtures.
truth_boundaries: This closes the direct exported PR-create bypass for missing expected head identity.

It does not make GitHub PR creation atomically conditional on the remote branch remaining at that head; post-create response head verification still detects but cannot erase a race that occurs inside the external service boundary.
